text:
Three electrical quantities are listed.
●
potential difference
●
electromotive force
●
current
Which quantities are measured in volts?
A
potential difference only
B
potential difference and current only
C
potential difference and electromotive force only
D
potential difference, electromotive force and current

options.label: C
options.text: potential difference and electromotive force only

options.label: D
options.text: potential difference, electromotive force and current
